notice.status: ASSUMPTION - not derived from ridership data
notice.disclaimer: All multiplier values in this file represent analytical planning assumptions based on historical metropolitan festival surges in India. They are not derived from empirical farebox, smart-card, or ticket sales telemetry and require validation with automated ticketing data.

low.name: Conservative (+20% to +80% surge)
low.description: Assumes moderate regional transit shifts with partial private-vehicle absorption.

base.name: Baseline (+40% to +150% surge)
base.description: Standard transit authority planning assumptions for metropolitan festival mobility.

high.name: Aggressive / Stress-Test (+60% to +200% surge)
high.description: High-density holiday surge stress test reflecting peak interstate terminus influx and mass shopping movements.
